Why do we keep sending it from the harness?" Add to your build: (a) the pool survives server restarts and swaps: write each saved prefix state to disk (sealed store, AIEN_KV_STORE_DIR rules in kv_persist.rs) and reload it at start, so the tool block is read ONCE EVER, not once per server start; (b) warm at start: on boot, restore every stored prefix before taking requests; (c) receipt: first new Hermes chat after a restart, time to first word. | 12:10Z coordinator, Drake: "let Hermes continue to send it that way. If anything changes vs production, update it in real time and only change the bits that need to be changed, so all the agents get the update at the same time." Build into the pool: (1) DIFF ON ARRIVAL: compare each request prefix to the pool token by token; restore at the longest match and re-read only from the first changed token (checkpoints every 2048 tokens and at every tool boundary inside the tools block, so a change costs the tokens from the nearest checkpoint before it). (2) STABLE-FIRST TOOL ORDER: the server renders tools in a remembered order (by name; a tool whose definition changed moves to the END of the block), so one changed tool re-reads only itself plus what follows, not the whole block.
